summary: Idaho County lookout station named in a July 1915 paper; lookout reports run to 1921; no source describes the site today.

sources.title: History of Forest Fire Lookouts on the Nez Perce National Forest

notes_for_editor: Thin record: a 1915 county newspaper report (quoted by both sites), a 1917 name and a 1921 fire report. No source gives the lookout's build date, design, later staffing, fate or present condition, so the story stops at 1921 and says so for today. The 1915 cabin is reported as planned; the story does not say it was built. Idaho Fire Lookouts says it found only one 1915 record yet also lists 1917 and 1921 references. Not used in the story: an NPS history of the Nezperce forest (npshistory.com, section 3) says the Buffalo Hump area was eliminated from the forest in 1904 and given national forest status again on 9 July 1921, so the 1915 station may have stood outside the forest boundary; a reviewer should check before anything is said about that. The forest-lookout history on fs.usda.gov/media/259200 has no Buffalo Hump entry. Not standing on the Idaho Fire Lookout Association standing list read on the day, but that list is not proof of removal. Peak height is from the Forest Service history, not from a lookout record.
